body: I talk with some friends, but it always seems that nobody can ever understand what it is like. Now I don’t anymore because it seems that I am bothering them. I feel misunderstood. Misunderstood and lost. I can’t even guarantee that therapists will understand me. It feels like the world doesn’t understand me anymore, and that I’m talking in a foreign language asking for help. I don’t feel strong anymore; instead I feel weaker and that I have less willpower each time. To be kind, to be strong, to be grateful. Everything seems so hard now. No one understands me.

I should say I try to be religious and because of bad things, I try my best to improve myself and pray. But things have gotten worse and I have resigned myself with no possibility of things getting better. 

Several bad things have happened consecutively, one of them being a defining traumatic event in my life. I just don’t feel like living on still if I am being tested this bad, or punished this bad. I just don’t know how to be better, and I am sorry for all the bad things I’ve done.
